info.title: DreamHub API
info.description: DreamHub's REST API (`/api/v1`). Every request names the box it is about with the optional `box` query parameter; without it the profile's first allowed box is used, so clients written before multi-box support keep working. Changes to a box are always two steps: `POST …/plan` returns a preview, `POST /plans/{id}/apply` applies it. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (Settings → Authentication → API tokens); a token acts as the profile that created it. Mutating requests need the header `X-DreamHub-Request: 1`. Operations marked `x-box: global` do not depend on the box. The set of operations is kept in step with the router by a test; schemas are filled in for the most useful endpoints first.

Box.name: box
Box.description: ID of the box (see `GET /boxes`). Omitted: the profile's default box, else the first one. `404 box_not_found` for an unknown ID, `403 box_forbidden` for one the profile may not use.
